newsitem.title: GERMANY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SUPER-G WINNER ALPHAND.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF SUPER-G WINNER ALPHAND.

text.p: Brief profile of the winner of the third men's World Cup super-G of the season on Friday:

World Cup wins: 11. Downhills - Kitzbuehel (97), Bormio (97), Val Gardena (97), Garmisch-Partenkirchen (96), Kitzbuehel I and II (95), Bormio (95), Vail (95), Val d'Isere (95). Super-Gs - Laax (97), Garmisch-Partenkirchen (97)

Other notable achievements. Twice World Cup downhill champion. Downhill bronze medallist at the 1996 world championships in Sierra Nevada, Spain. Career disrupted by serious injuries, list of which is nearly as long as his triumphs. After tearing knee ligaments at Whistler in 1993 he seriously considered retiring but is now serious contender to be first Frenchman to win overall World Cup title since 1968. Enjoys hunting, rallying and motocross.
